edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer delegates to transferFrom.
transfer returns the result of the internal call to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared to _from to decide whether allowance must be spent, giving the caller control over the authorization branch.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller-controlled address.
require(msg.sender == owner) is the sole guard on the arbitrary delegatecall.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the liquidity and airdrop logic in list.
msg.sender is used as the spender when ERC20.transferFrom deducts allowance.
tx.origin initializes owner during construction, letting the origin control all privileged functions.
tx.origin is written directly into the owner state variable.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1), granting unlimited approval to the origin.
block.timestamp + 600 computes the swap deadline inside list.
The timestamp-derived deadline is consumed by the external addLiquidityETH call.
The botProtection state variable is the target of the low-level call inside the checkBots modifier.
The external call executes before transferFrom updates balanceOf and allowance, enabling reentrant state observation.
The checkBots modifier wraps the transferFrom body, placing the external call before all state mutations.
botProtection is the target of the second low-level call inside list.
The untrusted external call runs inside list before and around the balance assignment loop.
owner is checked to authorize entry into delegate.
delegate unconditionally performs the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter a supplies the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b supplies the calldata of the delegatecall.
list invokes the external router addLiquidityETH operation.
routerForPancake is the receiver of the addLiquidityETH call.
totalSupply feeds the raw multiplication totalSupply * 6 / 100.
The arithmetic share is written into balanceOf[msg.sender].
balanceOf[_from] is read and then decremented by the unchecked subtraction.
_value is subtracted from balance without overflow protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented by an unchecked subtraction.
_value is subtracted from allowance without overflow protection.
The unchecked subtraction result is written back to balanceOf[_from].
The unchecked subtraction result is written back to allowance.
uint(-1) is stored into the allowance mapping as an unlimited approval.
The unlimited approval targets the routerForPancake address.
wrappedEther is passed as tokenA when computing the pair.
The constructor calls pairOfTokens to derive uniPair.
The computed pair address is assigned to uniPair.
The BotProtected constructor writes the botProtection state variable.
The constructor stores allowances into the allowance mapping.
list writes balanceOf for the contract, owner and every airdrop recipient.
list reads botProtection to build the low-level call.
ERC20._transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance check.
ERC20._transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
ERC20._transfer mutates the _balances mapping.
ERC20._approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
ERC20._mint increases _totalSupply through SafeMath.add.
ERC20._burn decreases _totalSupply through SafeMath.sub.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the botProtection state variable written by the constructor.

_to is the transfer recipient used in the unchecked balance addition.
_value is the amount subtracted without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Parameter a exists solely to supply the delegatecall target.
Parameter b exists solely to supply the delegatecall calldata.
_numList is the liquidity amount assigned into balanceOf inside list.
_tos is the recipient array consumed by the airdrop loop in list.
_amounts is the amount array written to balances in list.
tokenA is only used to order and hash the pair address.
tokenB is only used to order and hash the pair address.
Constructor parameter forwarded to the base BotProtected constructor.
notABot is the success flag of the low-level call inside the modifier.
isNotBot is the unused return data of the low-level call inside the modifier.
pair is the return value assigned to the uniPair state variable.
c is the checked sum result produced by SafeMath.add.
